metadata.name: terra_incognita
metadata.description: A global treasure hunt whose location lives inside a private ephemeral rollup

instructions.name: arm
docs: Starts the hunt once the treasure is sealed: publishes the commitment to the location
and commits the hunt to Solana so the commitment is anchored before anyone plays.

instructions.name: cancel_hunt
docs: Withdraws a hunt that was never delegated: closes the hunt, its board, treasure and
vault, prize seed included, back to the creator.

instructions.name: close_board
docs: Closes the released board of a finalized hunt and returns its rent, together with
whatever the hunt account holds beyond its own rent, to the creator.

instructions.name: close_logbook
docs: Closes a released logbook and returns its rent to the player.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The player who paid for the logbook decides when its record goes.

instructions.name: close_treasure
docs: Closes the released treasure of a finalized hunt. The hunt account keeps the revealed
location and salt; the zone seed and the closest sounding go with the treasure.

instructions.name: create_hunt
docs: Creates a hunt on Solana: the public hunt and board, the treasure that will hold the
secret, and the vault that keeps the prize until settlement.

instructions.name: delegate_hunt
docs: Delegates the hunt, its board and its treasure to the hunt's validator.
Accounts that are already delegated are skipped, so the call can be repeated.

instructions.name: delegate_hunt_sealed
docs: Author mode, sealed without a readable transaction: delegates the hunt, its board and
its treasure, and attaches to the treasure's delegation a post-delegation action that
the validator runs inside the rollup. The client encrypts the action's arguments, the
location and the salt, to the validator's key, so they never appear in clear on Solana
or in the rollup. The action has to be `seal_from_action` signed by the creator.

instructions.name: embark
docs: Makes the player's logbook private to its owner and operator and puts the airship
on the board at `start`. The sounding gear starts cold, so the first sounding has to
wait for the cooldown like any other.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Ends a decided hunt: reveals the location and salt, commits the hunt to Solana,
releases it from the rollup and schedules the payout in the same intent. Whether it
may run depends on the public hunt state alone.

instructions.name: join
docs: Enters a hunt on Solana: pays the entry fee into the vault, creates the player's
logbook and delegates it to the hunt's validator. `operator` is a session key that
may fly the airship on the owner's behalf; prizes always go to the owner.

accounts.name: hunt
docs: deserialized and address-checked in the handler.

instructions.name: open_hunt
docs: Opens the hunt inside the rollup: makes the treasure unreadable for everyone and, in
VRF mode, asks the oracle for the randomness that will place it.

instructions.name: open_logbook
docs: Makes a logbook readable by everyone once the hunt is over, so every hint in it can
be checked against the revealed location.

instructions.name: open_treasure
docs: Makes the treasure account readable by everyone once the hunt is over.

instructions.name: probe
docs: Takes a sounding where the airship is. The distance band goes into the private
logbook and a pin, without the band, goes on the public board.

instructions.name: reclaim_escrow
docs: Closes the escrow that pays for the settlement action once it is no longer needed,
and hands the creator everything the hunt account holds beyond its own rent.

instructions.name: refund_entry
docs: Returns an entrant's fee from the vault of a void hunt and closes their released
logbook, whose rent goes back to them as well. Anyone may send it.

instructions.name: release_board
docs: Returns the board and the treasure to Solana after the hunt.

instructions.name: release_logbook
docs: Returns a logbook to Solana after the hunt, where its rent can be reclaimed.

instructions.name: schedule_tick
docs: Registers a recurring `tick` with the Hydra scheduler of the rollup.

instructions.name: schedule_tick_legacy
docs: Registers a recurring `tick` with the validator's built-in task scheduler.

instructions.name: seal_from_action
docs: Author mode, run by the validator as the post-delegation action attached by
`delegate_hunt_sealed`: makes the treasure private and places it in one step.
`hunt` travels inside the encrypted arguments, so a copied ciphertext cannot seal a
different hunt with this hunt's location.

instructions.name: seal_from_author
docs: Author mode: the creator places the treasure. The transaction goes straight to the
rollup and is only accepted once `open_hunt` has made the treasure private.

instructions.name: seal_from_vrf
docs: VRF callback. Stores the oracle's output in the treasure and nothing else; the
location is derived from it when the hunt is armed.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: set_course
docs: Sends the airship towards `destination`. Only possible while it is not in flight.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Pays out the vault once the hunt is back on Solana in a final state. Scheduled by the
rollup together with the last commit, and callable by anyone as a fallback.

instructions.name: tick
docs: Advances the hunt from the clock, one step per call: promotes a strike made in an
earlier slot, closes the hunt at the deadline, shrinks the public zone, or finalizes
a hunt that has ended. Does nothing when there is nothing to do. Takes no signers so
a scheduler can drive it.

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: Hunt parameters are out of range

errors.name: InvalidHunt
errors.msg: The account is not a hunt of this program

errors.name: WrongStatus
errors.msg: The hunt is not in the required state

errors.name: NotSealed
errors.msg: The treasure has not been sealed yet

errors.name: AlreadySealed
errors.msg: The treasure is already sealed

errors.name: SealPending
errors.msg: A randomness request is still pending

errors.name: VrfNotRequested
errors.msg: No randomness was requested for this treasure

errors.name: WrongMode
errors.msg: This hunt uses a different sealing mode

errors.name: NotUnitVector
errors.msg: Coordinates must be a unit vector scaled by 1e9

errors.name: HuntFull
errors.msg: The hunt has no free seats

errors.msg: The hunt no longer accepts players

errors.name: NotLive

errors.name: NotStarted
errors.msg: The hunt has not started yet

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The deadline has passed

errors.name: NotPilot

errors.name: AlreadyEmbarked
errors.msg: The airship has already embarked

errors.name: NotEmbarked
errors.msg: The airship has not embarked

errors.name: InFlight
errors.msg: The airship is still in flight

errors.name: Cooldown
errors.msg: The sounding gear is cooling down

errors.name: ProbeLimit
errors.msg: The logbook is full

errors.name: NotEnded
errors.msg: The hunt has not ended

errors.name: AlreadyFinalized
errors.msg: The hunt is already finalized

errors.name: NotFinalized
errors.msg: The hunt is not finalized

errors.name: AlreadySettled
errors.msg: The vault is already settled

errors.name: NotRevealed
errors.msg: The treasure has not been revealed

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: UseRefund

errors.name: NotVoid

errors.name: ForeignSeal
errors.msg: The sealed action belongs to another hunt

types.name: Board
docs: Public state of a hunt: where every airship is and where the last soundings were taken.

fields.name: pin_count
docs: Total pins ever pushed; the ring slot of the next pin is `pin_count % PIN_RING`.

fields.name: ops_lamports
docs: Lamports left on the hunt account for rollup fees.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Set at finalisation; unlocks the audit openers.

fields.name: entropy
docs: Raw VRF output the location is derived from. Zero for author-placed treasures.

fields.name: best_dot
docs: Closest sounding so far; `NO_SOUNDING` until the first one.

fields.name: strike_player
docs: First sounding within striking distance. It stays here, unseen, until a later
`tick` promotes it to the public hunt state. A zero slot means no strike.
